data.one_liner: Provides Date, Time, and range classes with comparison and manipulation utilities.
data.what_it_does: The package defines separate Date and Time objects, supports copying, arithmetic, and overflow handling, and includes DateRange and TimeRange types for interval operations. It also offers extensions on DateTime and integrates with the clock package for testable time sources.
use_when: You need strong typed date or time handling beyond DateTime
You work with booking or scheduling logic requiring ranges and overflow logic
avoid_when: You only need simple DateTime usage without extra types
You require timezone-aware or locale‑specific date handling beyond what intl provides
strengths: Clear separation of date and time concepts
Range and overflow support out of the box
weaknesses: No built‑in timezone or locale‑aware parsing beyond intl
Limited ecosystem compared to more mature date libraries
